scripts.dev: npx concurrently "cd api && npm run start:dev" "cd app && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd app && npm run build && mkdir -p ../api/public && cp -r dist/* ../api/public/ && cd ../api && npm run build
scripts.test: concurrently "cd api && npm test" "cd app && npm run test"
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd api && npm run lint" "cd app && npm run lint"
scripts.format: concurrently "cd api && npm run format" "cd app && npm run format"
scripts.codegen: cd api && npm run openapi:generate && cd ../app && npm run codegen
